anatomy: Non-corporeal energy entity contained within a spherical glass life-support vessel; no fixed skeleton; a central, brain-like neural cluster glows with intense pink light
coloration: Translucent blue and violet gaseous body with shimmering nebula-like internal patterns; the neural core pulses with a hot magenta glow
attire_and_adornment: The containment sphere is reinforced with elegant silver filigree and ornate metallic bands inscribed with decorative motifs
posture_and_expression: Floating centrally within the sphere; tendrils of energy pulse rhythmically; the lack of a face makes the entity's mood unreadable but alien
distinctive_traits: This being exists entirely as a coherent field of energy and plasma, requiring sophisticated magnetic containment to interact with physical space
